name: Benzylbutylbarbiturate
summary: Benzylbutylbarbiturate (5-benzyl-5-n-butylbarbituric acid) is a rare example of a barbiturate designer drug, possibly the only such compound encountered in recent years.

summaryZh: 苄基丁基巴比妥酸是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C15H18N2O3，屬於一種巴比妥類藥物和策劃藥，2000年在日本被警方查獲。
